verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents a first-party MCP server ('Dynadot MCP') built on the Model Context Protocol, and a probe confirms it at dynadot.com/domain/mcp. Its documented tools cover availability checks, registration, account and domain viewing, and nameserver/DNS review. The evidence does not show how an agent actually connects, so the connection half of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented connection details (endpoint/transport, client configuration, authentication/API-key setup), coverage beyond the four listed read/register actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Dynadot MCP is an easier way to manage your domains, just by talking to an AI assistant.It uses the Model Context Protocol (MCP)

Check a domain name availability

official MCP server documented at https://www.dynadot.com/domain/mcp
